summary:
**Conversation Overview**

The person is working on client-facing materials for The Luxora Collective, a done-with-you growth program for medical spas. The core task was updating an existing 90-Day Transformation Roadmap document to match the exact phase order, deliverable sequence, and call structure laid out in the TLC 90-Day Client Action Checklist. The person provided the full checklist content directly in chat after file-reading tools were unavailable.

Claude restructured the roadmap to add Phase 0 (Pre-Kickoff Onboarding, Days 1-14) as a standalone section, insert the retargeting ads launch (Weeks 2-4) and Grand Slam offer build/launch (Weeks 5-8) which were missing from the prior version, correct playbook delivery timing (Partnership Playbook moved to Call #3, Longevity and Reputation Engine moved to Call #4), standardize all biweekly calls to 45 minutes, add explicit done-with-you framing with Luxora vs. client responsibilities, incorporate Slack-between-calls as the stated support model, and correct the Celebration Event timeline to Week 13 execution with playbook delivered Week 10. The full restructured roadmap was provided as text in chat. The person then requested it be saved as a Word document.

**Tool Knowledge**

Claude attempted to use bash tools to read the uploaded xlsx file from `/mnt/user-data/uploads/` and to generate a .docx file using the docx skill at `/mnt/skills/public/docx/SKILL.md`, but container/code-execution tools were offline throughout the session. A Google Drive file creation attempt using `Google Drive:create_file` with `contentMimeType: text/plain` also did not complete successfully, apparently due to a permissions issue. The session ended with the document delivered as in-chat text only, pending tool availability for file export. For future sessions, if bash and skill tools are unavailable, attempting Google Drive creation is a viable fallback, but Drive write permissions may need to be explicitly approved by the person before the tool call succeeds.

Your Complete Implementation Guide

____________________________________________________________

YOUR JOURNEY STARTS NOW

You just made a powerful decision. Investing in your business at this level takes courage, vision, and commitment. We don't take that lightly.

Over the next 90 days, we're going to work side-by-side with you to build something sustainable, scalable, and profitable. We're going to challenge you, push you, and hold you accountable, because that's what real transformation requires.

This is a done-with-you program. Luxora hands you the frameworks, runs your ads, builds your CRM and AI automations, and guides strategy through biweekly 45-minute check-ins. You and your team own the implementation inside your spa. Between calls, questions go in Slack, not daily calls or texts. • Market Blueprint (delivered 72 hours after onboarding checklist is complete)

We guarantee that the systems we build together will generate at least 2x your investment in new and recovered revenue within 90 days or we keep working until they do, at no additional cost to you.

____________________________________________________________

PHASE 0: PRE-KICKOFF ONBOARDING (DAYS 1-14)

Required items must be complete BEFORE your Strategy Kickoff Call. Market Blueprint delivers within 72 hours post-kickoff.

STEP 1: Required Before Kickoff (Days 1-7)

Three items must be complete before your kickoff call:
• Onboarding Checklist completed in full
• Signed Contract on file
• KPI Calculator with LTV Baseline filled in

If any of these are missing, your kickoff reschedules. This delays your timeline but does not restart the 90-day clock.

STEP 2: Strategy Kickoff Call (Day 7-10)

This is our first working session together, 90 minutes. We'll review your business goals, kick off your Market Blueprint, walk through your KPI baseline, and align on the 90-day roadmap. This is a working session, not a welcome call. Come prepared to go deep.

• 3-5 before/after photos (with client consent forms)
• 2-3 video testimonials, 30-60 seconds each
• 5-10 behind-the-scenes photos of your team and space

• Meta Business Manager and Google Ads (assign Luxora as a partner)

• Notify your team that sales training and new scripts are coming
